target_customer: Hospitals and neurologists that review EEG, starting with epilepsy and ICU monitoring
problem: Reading EEG recordings is slow and specialist heavy. Piramidal trains a foundation model on EEG to flag and review recordings in real time.
business_model: Clinical software and enterprise AI infrastructure for hospitals (pricing not public)
product_category: Brain foundation model and clinical EEG AI

founders.name: Dimitris Fotis Sakellariou
founders.background_notes: About 12 years of EEG research per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Training a foundation model on heterogeneous EEG across hardware and montages is research grade, and clinical use needs FDA clearance.

defensibility.rationale: Large EEG datasets, hospital partnerships and a pending 510(k) are hard to replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Ceribell and others were listed as EEG market players by an aggregator; no source found of copying or acquisition.

market_need_then: EEG review is a known specialist bottleneck, and foundation model methods were newly applicable; academic EEG foundation model work was emerging.

branding.community_and_virality: Press on the Cleveland Clinic partnership and TechCrunch coverage of the funding.

brand_strength.rationale: Name likely echoes pyramidal neurons (no source confirms) and gets press, but spelling differs from the anatomical term.

outcome_analysis: Piramidal raised a 6 million dollar seed in August 2024 and partnered with Cleveland Clinic. A domain expert CEO and a data heavy approach give it a technical and regulatory moat, but clinical clearance is still pending and the company has not disclosed accuracy metrics. No exit or trouble is reported.
notes: Sources conflict on the lead: one says co-led by Adverb and Lionheart, another says Y Combinator led. Press says founded 2023, YC says 2024. Competitor names from an undated aggregator were not recorded as dated competitors, so the list is empty. TechCrunch article was not opened. Kris Pahuja title from press via search summary.
